profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker CRNC and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001768267. On its own site, the company describes itself as delivering trusted physical AI through voice, multimodal understanding, contextual intelligence, and agentic architecture, proven at automotive scale and built for intelligent systems across industries. It says its platform provides the interaction and action layer for physical AI, helping people communicate and collaborate with vehicles, machines, and other intelligent systems.

The site describes an ecosystem of specialized AI agents that share context and coordinate actions, connected through Agent2Agent protocols, with guardrails and privacy controls and a flexible architecture spanning cloud, edge, or hybrid deployment. Named offerings on the site include Cerence xUI, described as a multimodal AI foundation combining speech, vision, and vehicle data for context-aware in-car experiences, and Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection (EVD), which the company says is deployed in production vehicles and can detect and localize more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries, from more than 300 meters away with interior microphones and beyond 800 meters with exterior microphones. The site also references work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants, and a third quarter results announcement citing revenue up 12% YoY, connected services revenue up 20% YoY, and operating cash flow of $20M supporting a first-ever share repurchase program.

The held record lists no lawsuits and no MCP servers for the company. It records a law exposure count of 191 for Massachusetts, where the company is headquartered.
